remaining: Recreate/fix room glass transparency in URP without assuming Cycles transmission equivalence.
Recreate or bake procedural wood/floor/wall appearance; review vehicle paint/chrome and vegetation alpha.
Profile renderer/material count, overdraw and lighting on intended hardware after import.
Review lighting/shadows/reflection probes and aliasing; current baseline uses one realtime directional light and simple ambient.
Perform full walking-route, headset ergonomics and collision tuning later; only four Editor human-scale stations and basic boundaries checked.

visual_audit.method: Actual Unity URP camera RenderRequest screenshots; PlayMode motion sampled through more than one natural loop. Overall cutaway temporarily hides 306 objects only for that capture; saved scene restores them.

findings.finding: Assigned transparent shaders/queue, but glazing appears opaque blue-gray and blocks factory sightlines. Transmission does not match Blender. Existing URP Opaque Texture remains disabled.
Table tops render white; procedural wood grain/color detail does not reproduce.
Surface placement and colors present. Procedural detail and lighting are flat; no Cycles match claimed.
Painted panels and robot material assignments readable. Reflection/roughness needs subsequent lighting review.
Imported colors/cutouts visible, no missing shader. Alpha edge quality and overdraw still need review.
Vehicle geometry and materials visible incidentally. Paint, chrome, clearcoat and glazing require dedicated URP lighting/material review.

collision.scope: Basic floor/major wall boundaries only; one irregular floor MeshCollider, other candidates BoxCollider. No detailed prop, vehicle, robot or task interaction colliders.
